diagnosis_candidates.description: The application configuration sets alerts.provider to 'email', but the only available NotificationSender implementation (WebhookNotificationSender) is conditionally registered only when alerts.provider is 'webhook'. Since there is no implementation for the 'email' provider, Spring cannot satisfy the NotificationSender dependency for NotificationService, resulting in an UnsatisfiedDependencyException.
diagnosis_candidates.recommended_fix: Implement a NotificationSender for the 'email' provider and annotate it with @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix = "alerts", name = "provider", havingValue = "email"), or change the alerts.provider property in application.yml to 'webhook' if the webhook sender is intended.

diagnosis_evidence.summary: The application fails to start because NotificationService requires a NotificationSender bean, but the only implementation (WebhookNotificationSender) is conditionally disabled. The application.yml configures alerts.provider as 'email', which does not match the 'webhook' condition, and no 'email' implementation exists.
